sam (AE): Looping everyone in on Lantern CRM POC - they want a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX's API. Main asks: request/response mapping, prompt param parity, rate-limit semantics, and security questionnaire. Can we scope POC blockers?
Devin (SE): On it. Do we have their example payloads + auth headers? Any special webhook callbacks?
Jordan (Lantern): Sending a sample request we use in prod below:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.competitorx.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}' 
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the ticket","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.7,"stop":["\\n\\n"]}'
```
Devin (SE): Thanks. Quick note: Redwood maps some params differently (for our hosted API): `temperature` -> `temp`, `max_tokens` -> `max_new_tokens`. Streaming uses SSE instead of chunked frames. Will produce a mapping doc.
Oliver (Eng): Heads up - streaming semantics differ: we send incremental token events and a final `done` object. CompetitorX sometimes sends partial text plus final deltas; clients that expect identical framing may need a shim. We'll add a compatibility shim for the POC staging route. Also need confirmation: Lantern doesn't rely on KV-cache session resumption, right?
Jordan (Lantern): No persistent KV resumption for us; we only do stateless calls.
Katie (Security): Security checklist: SOC2, KMS integration, SCIM/SSO, customer-side audit logs, data residency requirements. We can share our SOC2 report and fill their security questionnaire. Can they accept an MSA addendum for Dedicated IP allowlist?
Jordan (Lantern): KMS + SCIM required. We need encrypted-at-rest with customer-managed keys and SSO via Okta. Legal will request SOC2 and penetration test summary. Also: audit logs for who called which key.
sam (AE): Pricing question from Lantern: they currently pay CompetitorX ~$0.012/token for high-volume chat. They need a ballpark for 1M tokens/month with Redwood Hosted vs Dedicated (committed) and any migration credits for a 2-week POC. Can finance weigh in?
Devin (SE): I’ll draft three options: (A) Hosted list rate, (B) Reserved commit with X% discount, (C) Hybrid (committed baseline + burst). Include POC promo credits and staging discounts.
sam (AE): POC timeline: start next Monday, 2-week eval. Requirements: staging keys, route that enforces their prod rate limits, golden prompt set for parity checks. Can we provision?
Oliver (Eng): We can spin up a staging GPU pool and a compatibility proxy that rewrites headers and param names. Need their service-account email and IP ranges for allowlist. Will also configure rate-limit tokens-per-minute to mirror their prod.
Devin (SE): Quick mapping snippet I'll share for Lantern devs to test locally:
```bash
# CompetitorX -> Redwood mapping example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize the ticket","temp":0.7,"max_new_tokens":256,"stop":["\\n\\n"]}'
```
Devin (SE): Param notes: `top_p` -> `nucleus`, `n` -> `num_outputs`, `stop` preserved but ensure identical sequence encoding.
Jordan (Lantern): One more: CompetitorX's default stop handling sometimes trims trailing punctuation differently. We need parity on stop sequences and a list of 50 golden prompts so we can diff outputs. If deltas are large, we need a mitigation plan (prompt engineering, normalizer, or different model).
Oliver (Eng): Agreed. We'll generate a 50-case golden set and run batch diffs between CompetitorX and our candidate models. If delta > threshold for >10% cases, we'll iterate on temperature/model and offer a normalization pass (post-process to align stops/whitespace).
Katie (Security): Sending the security questionnaire to Jordan's legal point-of-contact. Reminder: do not paste any PHI into these threads. :lock:
deploy-bot: Provisioned staging keys for lantern-poc (expires in 14d). Keys: redwood-staging-lantern-01 (rotatable).
sam (AE): Great. Devin/Oliver - can you attach the mapping doc + golden prompt set to the shared drive and ping here by EOD tomorrow? Katie will follow up with SQA answers and SOC2.
Devin (SE): Will upload mapping doc + 50 golden prompts to the shared drive and post link here. :thumbsup:
Oliver (Eng): I'll also add a short README for the compatibility shim and a list of known response deltas to watch for.
Jordan (Lantern): Thanks team - looking forward to the POC. We'll send service-account + IP allowlist by EOD today.
sam (AE): Perfect - flag any enterprise blockers (legal SSO, KMS, dedicated IPs) as soon as possible so we can escalate to Solutions Ops.
